'''Algimantas Adolfas Jucys''' (14 November 1936 – 29 July 1997) was a [[Lithuania]]n theoretical physicist  more prominent as a  [[mathematician]], a son of [[Lithuania]]n physicist [[Adolfas Jucys]]. Since 1967 Algis Jucys was researcher at the Institute of Physics and Mathematics of [[Lithuanian Academy of Sciences]], in 1977-1990 at the Institute of Physics and in 1990-1996 at the Institute of Theoretical Physics and Astronomy, Lithuania.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.itpa.lt/baryon/Jucys/Jucysen.html |title=Jucys |access-date=2011-05-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110807115938/http://www.itpa.lt/baryon/Jucys/Jucysen.html |archive-date=2011-08-07 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

Algimantas (Algis) Adolfas (A.-A.A.) Jucys was member of Lithuanian Physical Society, [[Lithuanian Mathematical Society]], American Mathematical Society. [[Jucys–Murphy element]]s in the [[group ring|group algebra]] <math>\mathbb{C} [S_n] </math> of the [[symmetric group]] are named after him.
